rationale: Describes unified communications functions (IP telephony, web and video conferencing, voicemail, instant messaging, presence) and API integration with business applications. These are conventional communication functions with no AI mention.
evidence_spans: Collaboration tools including IP telephony for voice calling, web and video conferencing (Webex), voice mail, mobility, desktop sharing, instant messaging (Jabber) and presence, and more.
integrate with everyday business applications using APIs
